The description lists the four models and the four colors but does not explicitly map which color corresponds to which model, as shown in the legend (e.g., light blue is mBERT-targ).

The value for the 'XLM-targ' bar in the 'IE-Baltic' category is approximately 15. While this value is correct, stating it is a 'relatively high' value is misleading in the context of the same group, where the 'mBERT-targ' bar has a higher value of approximately 22.
